en.headline: Hong Kong and Guangdong sign yacht travel work arrangements
en.dek: The Marine Department and the Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration signed papers covering Guangdong yachts entering Hong Kong waters and Hong Kong yachts sailing north, with southbound details still to come.
body: The Marine Department and the Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration signed two work arrangements on Monday to advance cross-boundary yacht visits between Hong Kong and Guangdong, covering Guangdong-registered yachts entering Hong Kong waters and Hong Kong yachts travelling into Guangdong.

A Transport and Logistics Bureau spokesperson said the documents create an institutional basis for two-way yacht travel and mark a milestone for individual yacht travel in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Hong Kong yachts have been able to sail north to nine Mainland GBA cities since June under a facilitation scheme.

The bureau said it is completing final preparations for the southbound scheme that would let Guangdong yacht owners visit Hong Kong with similar convenience, and that implementation details would be announced later. Officials said the policy is intended to support cross-boundary leisure spending.

Director of Marine Wong Sai-fat and Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration director Chen Chuanquan signed the arrangements. The Marine Department said it would keep working with Guangdong authorities on both directions of travel.

The yacht economy is listed as a priority in the city’s first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address. The Policy Address had earlier said the Marine Department would sign a memorandum with the Guangdong side to implement southbound travel.

zh.headline: 港粵簽署遊艇互訪工作安排 粵艇南下進入最後準備
zh.dek: 海事處與廣東海事局周一簽署「粵艇南下」及「港艇北上」工作安排，當局稱稍後公布廣東籍遊艇訪港實施細節。
body: 海事處與廣東海事局周一簽署《便利廣東籍遊艇進出香港水域工作安排》及《香港遊艇入出廣東工作安排》，推進兩地遊艇跨境互訪。
運輸及物流局發言人表示，有關文件為港粵遊艇互訪建立制度化基礎，是粵港澳遊艇自由行的重要一步。香港遊艇自今年6月起可經便利措施前往大灣區內地九市。
發言人指，當局正進行「粵艇南下」最後階段準備，讓廣東省遊艇船主可以相近便利訪港，實施細節稍後公布，並期望帶動跨境休閒消費。
兩份文件由海事處處長王世發與廣東海事局局長陳傳全簽署。海事處表示會繼續與廣東省相關部門合作，推行南北雙向措施。
遊艇經濟是本港首份五年規劃及2026年《施政報告》的重點項目之一。《施政報告》較早前亦提到海事處將與廣東海事局簽署文件，落實粵艇南下。
